tier1.text: The cervical vertebrae, the seven bones of the spine in the neck, give the neck a wide range of motion. Cervical vertebrae carry the least body weight, so they have small bodies, the weight-bearing front parts. An artery that supplies the brain runs up the neck through openings in the cervical vertebrae.

sentences.text: The cervical vertebrae, the seven bones of the spine in the neck, give the neck a wide range of motion.

quotes.quote: In the neck, the articular processes of cervical vertebrae are flattened and generally face upward or downward. This orientation provides the cervical vertebral column with extensive ranges of motion for flexion, extension, lateral flexion, and rotation.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: cervical vertebrae: seven vertebrae numbered as C1–C7 that are located in the neck region of the vertebral column
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Cervical vertebrae carry the least body weight, so they have small bodies, the weight-bearing front parts.

quotes.quote: Cervical vertebrae have a small body, reflecting the fact that they carry the least amount of body weight.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: The body is the anterior portion of each vertebra and is the part that supports the body weight.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: An artery that supplies the brain runs up the neck through openings in the cervical vertebrae.

quotes.quote: Each transverse process also has an opening called the transverse foramen. An important artery that supplies the brain ascends up the neck by passing through these openings.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
